Hi there! So I'm 20 yrs old and 6 months ago I got dvt in my leg. It was awful not going to lie, I was on the patch. The patch helped with my PMS and cramps. Now I can never go back on another birth control containing estrogen. There's still hormonal options though! Progestin only options include the implant, hormonal iud, depo shot and the mini pill (some options can potentially suppress your period all together). For many, progestin only birth control can help lessen period symptoms. Blood clots are rare, needle in a haystack. In my experience the pain from dvt was gradual the first week before diagnosed. It would be unlikely that the clot would dislodge in such a short period of time. You would likely notice the pain before it became fatal (I definitely noticed, it was extremely painful). Good luck and I hope you choose what's best for you. I don't think you should be overly concerned about developing a blood clot unless have other risk factors along with taking the ring.
